dhanushk-offl-resume-parser-resume-parse.description: Deeply parses resume PDFs using the OpenResume 4-step algorithm, extracts structured information (Name, Email, Phone, Education, Work Experience, Skills, etc.), evaluates ATS compatibility, and provides actionable improvement suggestions. Use when a user asks to parse, review, or analyze a resume, check ATS-friendliness, or get resume improvement suggestions.
